questions.stem: A 55-year-old chronic alcoholic presents with complaints of recurrent epigastric pain, progressive weight loss, and foul-smelling diarrhoea for the past 6 months. CT scan reveals pancreatic calcification and dilatation of the main pancreatic duct. Which of the following statements is false about his condition?

options.label: A
options.text: It is more common in males

options.label: C
options.text: Abdominal pain is the most common symptom

options.label: D
options.text: Pain increases as destruction of the pancreas progresses
